gen-gf-pt-mono-fs-bespoke-sans: Fixed-width, code-style letters with a jaw-open c give PT Mono its personality. Bespoke Sans follows with sharp, refined curves that leave generous room before the stem, so a long passage moves smoothly and stays light.
gen-gf-pt-mono-fs-literata: Typewriter precision meets bookish warmth, each PT Mono shape standing clear in its own gap above the serif text below. Literata's sturdy strokes swell gently and settle things.
gen-gf-pt-sans-fs-literata: Literata reads like a well-loved paperback, its curves wide-mouthed and its thick strokes only slightly heavier than the thin. PT Sans brings open-handed round letters and a contemporary tone, which is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-pt-sans-narrow-fs-literata: Literata sets a text serif with sturdy thin lines, slightly heavier thick ones, and curves that stay wide open. And PT Sans Narrow above it, brushed on with barely a gap between letters, gives a long page a brisk, approachable headline voice.
gen-gf-quantico-fs-literata: Literata is the bookish half, with sturdy thin lines and softly varied stroke thickness. Quantico adds crossbars as fat as their stems, like a technical drawing pen, and Literata keeps the text warm beside it.
gen-gf-quattrocento-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space between its curve ends and the stem. Quattrocento carries the literary side, its curves thickened slightly like a reed pen, and that old-world touch is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-quattrocento-sans-fs-literata: Literata reads with a comfortable thick and thin variation, curves opening wide like a familiar paperback. Quattrocento Sans gives each round letter a clear channel in, and the contrast with the serif is gentle.
gen-gf-radley-fs-bespoke-sans: Gaping curves, a literary swagger, all in Radley. Bespoke Sans stays low in contrast and spacious around its curves, so give it a touch more size than the heading needs.
gen-gf-ramaraja-fs-bespoke-sans: Heavy trunks with whisper-thin branches, tightly spaced, give Ramaraja its authority. And Bespoke Sans, sharp and generous around its curves, lets a long passage move with ease beside that density.
gen-gf-ramsina-fs-bespoke-sans: Crowded terminals and tight, glass-thin spacing make Ramsina feel dignified and bookish. Bespoke Sans does the opposite job, opening its curves and keeping stroke weight low, where Ramsina's noticeably shifting weight does the heading's work.
